The '''Drill Site Control Center''' was a drilling platform located above the [[abandoned mining mesa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. Around [[3638 BBY]], [[Nadrin Tro]] worked at this location in order to save the planet's core from destruction.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Imperial|Descent into the Core|Makeb}}</ref>
